prompt:
Create ONE revised high-fidelity Chinese game UI image by editing reference 1. Output 1672x941 landscape. Reference 1 is the exact layout/content target; references 2 and 3 are the existing game's accepted Cold Steel icon STYLE references ONLY, not objects to insert everywhere. The user dislikes the dated, chunky, rustic icons and wants a refinement grounded in the existing Cold Steel UI planning and FONT settings.

ABSOLUTELY PRESERVE the integrated information architecture: upper scenic castle strip; within the lower console top row exploration progress and agent invasion; left route diagram, right selected-node dossier; five-category expected-rewards ribbon below the route; bottom safe evacuation and forced abandonment with consequence warnings. Preserve all requested sections. This is a VISUAL STYLE / TYPOGRAPHY refinement, not a new layout. Preserve moon/castle/candles/skull/raven scenery and its atmosphere from reference 1. No UI moved back onto the scenery. No new features.

STYLE CORRECTION IS THE MAIN TASK:
Reference 1 is too medieval, embossed, tarnished and decorative. Remove its stacked double/triple carved frame lines, all corner rivets, fake battered leather texture, antique medallions, grotesque sculpted skull trophies, compass ornament next to the title, hooded figurine next to invasion, and skull-and-bones decoration on the abandon button. Remove pointless aggressive beveled button lettering.
Use the material language of references 2/3: precise manufactured silver-gray beveled metal, graphite flat faces, clean geometric cuts, restrained machining, crisp silhouettes, subtle smooth facet shading. Much LESS detail and MUCH thinner rims at small UI sizes than those full-size references. This should look like a coherent modern Cold Steel tactical archive within a dark fantasy game. Do NOT import reference 3's saturated cyan energy into the whole interface.
The panel should be primarily calm matte graphite, with just one fine silver border, subtle top-edge reflection, modest corner cuts or 6-10px rounded corners. Reduce the former giant section frames to thin separators and comfortable space. No rust, gold trim, ornate scrollwork, reptile/leather textures, scratched-grunge panels, giant cast iron hardware, or circular silver coins everywhere. Keep tasteful fine material depth so it does not become a generic web dashboard.

EXACT PROJECT TYPOGRAPHY DIRECTION:
Chinese/UI font: Microsoft YaHei UI / Microsoft YaHei / PingFang SC / Noto Sans CJK SC, clean modern SANS SERIF. Pure numbers: Consolas-style monospace with aligned tabular digits.
Use ONLY four nominal desktop sizes in the hierarchy: section main title 20px weight700, subheadings16px weight600, body/buttons14px normal or medium, auxiliary notes12px normal. Consistently render crisp legible text at this image's scale. Do not shrink critical warnings to tiny copy. No oversized 30-40px main buttons, no ornamental display fonts, no Songti/Ming-style serifs, no brush/calligraphic strokes, no pseudo-engraving on text, no text shadow or bevel. Keep Chinese natural spacing: title tracking about0.08em maximum, labels0.04em, normal body spacing. Body line-height1.55, title1.25. The old image's giant chunky "探索规划", "进入节点", "安全撤离", "强制放弃" must become clearly more restrained and typographically consistent. Hierarchy must be built with spacing and weight, not giant text.

PALETTE FROM REAL PROJECT:
#090c0f deepest, #101419 soft black, #171d23 charcoal, #232b33 graphite, #34414b controls, #eef3f5 primary text, #9ca8b1 secondary, #c4d3da silver selection, #8ea6b2 muted accent. A single thin border, muted highlights. No pure-black dead zones. Risk/destructive values may use muted rust-red. Safe status a tiny muted green dot only, not a green button. Currency icon neutral silver, no big gold medals.

ICON REFINEMENT:
Route node housings become thin, precise hexagonal/chamfered compact frames referencing the game's real hexagonal icon family (refs2/3), approximately46-52px display size. Keep generous inter-node spacing. Symbols inside are clean, coherent, shallow silver cut-metal silhouettes with simple flat facets and readable negative space, NOT tiny detailed sculptures. Start: simplified geometric gate; combat: two clean straight blade silhouettes; elite: pared-back angular horned-mask silhouette (no protruding ornate horns/teeth); reward: simple modernized lockbox; unknown: tidy neutral question glyph. Same scale, lighting and edge weight across all. Current and selected nodes get a precise thin bright silver outline, no glowing blue ball.
Dossier elite icon is the EXACT same simplified glyph as its route node, only modestly larger (~48px), not a skull bust.
Utility/reward icons, if needed, are small18-24px silver silhouettes, no surrounding medallions: small currency token, chest/box, garment, tribute shard. Omit purely decorative icons next to textual section headers and buttons. Do not recycle horned skulls as currency/tribute/exit icons. Invasion needs at most one understated abstract warning glyph; abandonment uses text plus consequence, no pirate-skull icon.

CONTENT AND PLACEMENT MUST REMAIN:
TOP CONSOLE ROW:
"探索规划" | "恐怖地牢 · D级" | "探索进度 0 / 45"
Right: "时空特工入侵" "0%" and "尚未开始判定", with very thin unobtrusive meter. The number0% can be20px, no bigger.
MAIN:
Left approx70% has four ordered branch lanes with mild stagger and clean curves from current start. Keep no line crossings or tangles; don't make the map a rigid perfect matrix. Current label "当前位置". Only direct connection to first adjacent selected elite node bright silver, selected label "可前往". Future links dashed subdued gray and nodes muted but readable. No chain of several highlighted nodes implying skips.
Small secondary text controls at map upper-right: "路线总览" "当前位置".
Right approx30%: "节点档案", compact matching elite glyph, "精英遭遇", small "可前往", "风险" / "较高" (muted red), "收益" / "较高", "准备充分后再前往".
Main button "进入节点": simple flat graphite-to-gray control, thin light border,14px or16px label only; optional small right arrow, no double-cut ornate frame. Strongest action by contrast and placement, not size.
REWARD RIBBON, still inside panel below map:
"预期收益" and smaller "地牢规则预览 · 非已获得".
Five open groups with aligned label/value baselines, subtle short separators:
"首领金币" / "5,500–6,500"
"通关金币" / "5,000 起"
"竞技场宝箱" / "75% · 1,800金" / "强化石1 / 重铸券1必得"
"精英附加" / "优质装备 · 50%"
"祭品范围" / "普通—传说"
No guaranteed earned-total invention. Reduce icons to leave readable text room.
BOTTOM EVACUATION RAIL, same locations:
"撤离管理"; modest clean "安全撤离" button; explanatory "仅起点可用 · 保留战利品".
Separated to right: smaller "强制放弃" action, muted danger border/text, with clearly readable "丢失背包全部物品" and "需二次确认". Keep secondary to entering a node. No skull on this button.
Frame shows the start node, so safe evacuation can be enabled. Don't alter these gameplay conditions.

The result must visibly correct the user's complaint: a refined, crisp, lighter-touch Cold Steel Archive visual system, cleaner icons rooted in references2/3, and disciplined Microsoft-YaHei-style type. It should feel less decorative and less dated than reference1 while preserving every function, the asymmetrical map/dossier composition, the integrated lower controls and the gothic scenery. One complete high-fidelity screen, no comparison board, annotations, labels of versions, or device frames.
